name: Sips and Sonnets
source:
In a quiet English town, Ms. Meadows runs a cozy tea boutique. Once an accomplished journalist, she used her modest savings to open the shop. With no family and a few customers, Ms. Meadows fills her days listening to the stories of those willing to share. Each night, inspired by her encounters at the tea shop, Ms. Meadows writes her latest poem, after Lilianne the nurse arrives to administer her medication.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176190/Sips_and_Sonnets/]Steam[/url]]
